For my patients

AI tools I recommend

Chatbots I built for my patients. Use them to think through habits, food, and questions before your visit. They do not know your medical history and do not replace your care team.

Alex the Health Guide↗An AI guide for realistic talk about food, exercise, and habits.Plants Are Your Friends↗Ask a chatbot about eating more whole plant foods.

AI can sound confident and still be wrong. Use these tools for ideas and preparation, not diagnosis or medication changes. Do not enter your name, birth date, or other identifying details.

For anything urgent, call your care team. In an emergency, call 911.

Educational information from Gennady Gelman, MD. Not medical advice for you; your own clinician can tell you what fits your health.

In an emergency, call 911. For a mental health crisis, call or text 988.
